headword: {入場料|にゅうじょうりょう}

definitions.explanation: The fee charged to enter a venue such as a museum, amusement park, concert, or sporting event.

examples.japanese: {入場料|にゅうじょうりょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧1000⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The admission fee is 1000 yen for adults.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{入場料|にゅうじょうりょう}⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{入場料|にゅうじょうりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}って→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I paid the admission fee and went inside.

notes:
{入場料|にゅうじょうりょう} is what you pay to get into a venue — an amusement park, a concert, a sports ground, an exhibition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入場料|にゅうじょうりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay admission
- {入場料|にゅうじょうりょう}⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧: admission free
- {入場料|にゅうじょうりょう}⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧ / {入場料|にゅうじょうりょう}⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧: admission included / not included

CHOOSING THE RIGHT FEE WORD:
Japanese uses a different compound depending on what is being entered, and signs use them precisely:
- ⟦{入館料|にゅうかんりょう}→入館料：07141_nyuukanryou⟧ for buildings whose name ends in ⟦{館|かん}→館：17308_kan⟧ — museums, libraries, halls
- ⟦{拝観料|はいかんりょう}→拝観料：07059_haikanryou⟧ for temples and shrines, where you are paying to view something venerated
- {入場料|にゅうじょうりょう} for open grounds and events

DISCOUNTS:
Ticket windows normally list ⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧ (group), ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧ (student), and ⟦シニア→シニア：08830_shinia⟧⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧ (senior) rates.
